data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a mail draft that ends in Discard) and the same email format. It adds a redundant recipient_name parameter when the true name is the client part of the email, it adds a "billion" and ISO-code formatting detail that the true body template doesn't have, and it doesn't say that the recipient address is {client}@example.com, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
